AccountDecision.description:
The outcome of an admin's decision on a dealer or expert application (common/account_status.py), returned by
both routes that decide one. `email_delivered` says whether the applicant's decision email reached the mail server
(SRDS §9); False when email is off in this environment or the send failed, so the admin can follow up.
AccountDecision.title: AccountDecision

DealerApplicationInput.description: The business half of a dealer's application. The lengths match the table's checks.
DealerApplicationInput.title: DealerApplicationInput

DecideAccountRequest.description:
An admin's decision on a pending dealer (SRDS §8, §12). A rejection carries the reason the applicant will read
on their Application Status screen, so it must say something (decide_account_status() enforces the same).
DecideAccountRequest.title: DecideAccountRequest

ExpertApplicantRef.description: The account half of an expert's application, for the admin (SRDS §12).
ExpertApplicantRef.title: ExpertApplicantRef

ExpertForAdmin.description: The admin reads add the account, the verification history (one record per submission) and the documents.
ExpertForAdmin.title: ExpertForAdmin

FarmCropWithCrop.description: Reads embed the crop; create and update return the bare row.
FarmCropWithCrop.title: FarmCropWithCrop

InventoryItemWithListing.description: The list and detail reads embed the linked listing; create, update and adjust return the bare row.
InventoryItemWithListing.title: InventoryItemWithListing

ListingWithRelations.description: Browse, detail and moderation reads embed the category and the owner; create and update do not.
ListingWithRelations.title: ListingWithRelations

Location.description: The structured place stored as jsonb on farms, stores, listings and experts.
Location.title: Location

ProblemDetail.description: RFC 9457 problem details. `code` is a stable machine-readable identifier; `title` is English text.
ProblemDetail.title: ProblemDetail

RegisterDocumentRequest.description:
A file the applicant has uploaded to their own folder of their role's bucket, to attach to the application.
The size and type are read from Storage by the database (fill_application_document), never taken from here.
RegisterDocumentRequest.title: RegisterDocumentRequest

RequiredDocument.description: One document an applicant of a role is asked for (SRDS §7: the list is configurable, by an admin).
RequiredDocument.title: RequiredDocument

RequiredDocumentInput.description: A new document applicants of a role are asked for (SRDS §7: configurable). `code` is a stable machine name.
RequiredDocumentInput.title: RequiredDocumentInput

RequiredDocumentUpdate.description: A change to one entry. It is never deleted, only retired (`active: false`): sent documents point at it.
RequiredDocumentUpdate.title: RequiredDocumentUpdate

ReviewVerificationRequest.description:
An admin's decision on a pending expert application (SRDS §11, §12). Suspension is no longer a decision: it
is the account's suspension (PATCH /admin/users/{id}/suspend), like every other role's. A rejection carries the
reason the expert reads on their Application Status screen.
ReviewVerificationRequest.title: ReviewVerificationRequest
